children: Thailand’s exports soared 24.0% yoy to USD 38.44 billion in September 2026, surpassing market forecasts of a 17.9% rise, though easing slightly from 24.3% in August, which marked the fastest growth.

Export growth was mainly supported by an increase in sales of industrial products, which rose 25.4%, marking the 30th consecutive month of growth, driven mainly by higher sales of computers and related equipment (59.4%), telephones and components (117.5%), and circuit boards (45.9%).
Shipments of agricultural products grew 8.1%, marking the third straight month of expansion.
Shipments to the US, Thailand’s largest export market, jumped 50.1% year-on-year, while those to China and Japan rose 18.4% and 19.0%, respectively.
For the January–September period, exports increased 19.6% from the same period in 2025, reaching USD 304.6 billion.
In July, the Commerce Ministry maintained its forecast for export growth of 8% this year, supported by easing global tensions and strong tech demand.

title: Thailand Export Growth Tops Forecasts
